intro: The Golden City at the edge of the Thar. That is Jaisalmer in one line — but there is a lot more to it. This guide covers when to go, where to stay and what not to miss.

sections.heading: Why visit Jaisalmer
paragraphs: Jaisalmer (Rajasthan) is known for its desert, heritage and adventure experiences. Overall it is mid-range — comfortable stays and good food without overspending.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is October to March.

faq.q: When is the best time to visit Jaisalmer?

faq.q: Where should I stay in Jaisalmer?
faq.a: Popular choices: Inside or below the fort for atmosphere; Desert camps for one night; Hotels near Gadisar Lake.
